repairs.finding: DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE.json binds source/constants and distribution METADATA but not the Python executable or loaded PyTorch/CPU FFT shared-library bytes and backend configuration used by the enabled adapter.
repairs.exact_repair: Bind and preflight an immutable environment/container digest or an equivalent executable-byte closure covering Python, loaded PyTorch/CPU FFT shared objects, and torch build/backend configuration. Preserve the current closure as historical evidence.

repairs.finding: voltage_identity.preflight permits stat-and-hash of the binary, but read_accounting freezes only endpoint os.pread calls. A fresh full-file hash is therefore outside the claimed exact read/byte accounting.
repairs.exact_repair: For this bounded contract require validation of a named, reviewed existing full-file hash receipt without rereading the binary, or separately freeze, bound, receipt, and include all preflight binary reads in the resource contract.

repairs.finding: retained_pair_correlation requests one frozen invalid reason but does not define correlation-specific reason codes or their priority, and the tests do not execute numeric correlation/channel/frame/invalid cases.
repairs.exact_repair: Freeze an ordered correlation reason-code list and add bounded numeric known-answer fixtures for positive and negative correlations, channel intersection/order, absolute-frame overlap, missing endpoint, insufficient channels, insufficient frames, nonfinite values, and zero norm.

scope.can_establish: The accepted method components are internally coherent and reproduce on the observed H1 runtime.
scope.cannot_establish: Exact future executable identity, exact total recording I/O, deterministic correlation invalid statuses, any waveform outcome, biological identity, or purity.
